name: Shigure
source:
A young man belonging to the Gohongatana Clan (lit., "Five Swords Clan" or "Five Katanas Clan"), who are in charge of organizing the Emperor's burial and other religious ceremonies. 
However, due to certain circumstances, the Gohongatana Clan clashed with the military, and was removed from the government affairs. 
Currently, Shigure opposes the military's plans and is in direct conflict with them, which puts his life in danger.

"Don't worry, I will stop your blow without fail".
